summary: quality lens over ONBOARDING-V2-1-T1 (98 product path(s), 59c4337..f2ee254, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 8 blocking, 2 non-blocking. chunk 1/3: 2 finding(s), chunk 2/3: 5 finding(s), chunk 3/3: 3 finding(s).

blocking_findings.summary:
[P1] Scope onboarding progress mutations to the authenticated app (apps/core/src/adapters/storage/postgres/repositories/onboarding-setup-repository.postgres.ts:209): Reviewer: chunk 1/3

`updateProgress` identifies the row only by the caller-supplied setup UUID and accepts an arbitrary actor ID; the repository API does not even receive the authenticated app ID.

[P1] Split the 676-line browser onboarding route (apps/core/src/control/server/routes/browser-onboarding.ts:1): Reviewer: chunk 1/3

The new `browser-onboarding.ts` route is 676 lines, directly violating ONBOARDING-V2-1-T1-AC10's requirement that route/page modules remain below 300 lines and the review brief's mandatory responsibility-boundary split.

[P1] Validate the model selection before committing the setup (apps/core/src/application/onboarding/onboarding-setup.service.ts:42): Reviewer: chunk 2/3

`createOrResume` accepts every non-empty `modelAlias` and checks only that the harness is one of the known strings before persisting the onboarding graph.

[P1] Require a valid approver before issuing the verification challenge (apps/core/src/control/server/routes/browser-onboarding.ts:542): Reviewer: chunk 2/3

The final readiness check before inserting a verification only requires a setup and an active conversation install.

[P1] Treat Content-Length: 0 as an empty verification request (apps/core/src/control/server/routes/browser-model-providers.ts:178): Reviewer: chunk 2/3

The stored-credential flow intentionally sends a POST with no body, but `hasBody` tests only whether the `content-length` header exists.

[P1] Split the onboarding route at the required responsibility boundaries (apps/core/src/control/server/routes/browser-onboarding.ts:676): Reviewer: chunk 2/3

This new route module is 676 lines, more than twice AC10's explicit 300-line ceiling, and combines authentication, status projection, manifest delivery, setup orchestration, verification creation, expiry, and projection retry with direct persistence queries.

Imported variable fonts are referenced under the wrong family names (apps/web/src/styles.css:42): Reviewer: chunk 3/3

The new Fontsource packages define their faces as `DM Sans Variable` and `Schibsted Grotesk Variable`, but these tokens request `DM Sans` and `Schibsted Grotesk`; no corresponding static sans/display faces are imported.

Persist the created channel account before discovery can fail (apps/web/src/features/onboarding/use-onboarding-controller.ts:285): Reviewer: chunk 3/3

`createChannelAccount` completes its server-side mutation before conversation discovery runs, but `accountId` is not saved and accepted secrets are not cleared until after discovery succeeds.

ONBOARDING-V2-1-T1-AC1: The task worktree hydrates decisions 0162 and 0163, both V2 specifications, and the V2 HTML reference from planning commit 829500087; the reference has SHA-256 c1dc1305abd4876f74ac7b0c8e097205c891b3478fb3ab7f7db1ec6f72259a45, and feat/v2-onboarding remains untouched.

ONBOARDING-V2-1-T1-AC2: The splash and all four onboarding steps conform to the immutable V2 reference in light and dark themes, saved and system reduced-motion modes, and 1920x956, 1469x800, 1280x800, 1024x768, 768x1024, and 375x812 viewports, with only documented deterministic masks.

ONBOARDING-V2-1-T1-AC3: The same-origin browser onboarding facade requires administrator session auth, trusted Origin, CSRF, and hosted recent reauthentication; rejects Bearer credentials and automatic mutation replay; sends no-store responses; uses the repository browser error envelope documented in OpenAPI with x-gantry-browser-auth; and keeps browser, audit, and error projections secret-free.

ONBOARDING-V2-1-T1-AC4: The focused onboarding application service atomically creates the custom role, Agent, service Person, desired-state revision, audit event, and resumable setup; one setup exists per app, explicit retry reuses its idempotency key, a changed payload conflicts, and upstream changes invalidate only dependent progress.

ONBOARDING-V2-1-T1-AC5: Model setup accepts only the exact agentHarness values auto, anthropic_sdk, and deepagents and only compatible credential modes; a candidate is verified through the shared model-provider preflight before persistence, failed candidates preserve a prior healthy credential, models stay unavailable until validation, and successful secret inputs clear.

ONBOARDING-V2-1-T1-AC6: Channel setup stores only runtime-owned gantry-secret references, supports the existing direct, env:, and aws-sm: reference modes when policy permits, returns a typed policy-disabled result otherwise, never projects channel secrets into agent capability secrets, and requires non-empty real conversation discovery before completion.

ONBOARDING-V2-1-T1-AC7: Provider selection is deterministic from live capability and provider support, Slack is preselected only when supported, Teams remains setup-only, provider accounts are Agent-owned with service-Person projection, direct-message approvers derive automatically from the counterpart, and group approvers require the recognized installer or validated manual membership.

ONBOARDING-V2-1-T1-AC8: The verification challenge persists account, conversation, canonical thread, code, inbound message, outbound message, and onboarding run identity; the run identity is carried through outbound send metadata and its persisted projection; expiry, replay, account/conversation/thread/code mismatch, outbound-before-inbound, and projection failure are typed, and projection retry preserves a satisfied challenge.

ONBOARDING-V2-1-T1-AC9: Exactly one generator-produced current-schema pre-release migration and snapshot covers resumable setup, verification correlation, provider-account correlation, constraints, and indexes; lifecycle tables use UUID row identifiers and actor/timestamp audit fields, archive migration history is excluded, the migration is regenerated from a clean baseline, and the migration directory remains clean afterward.

ONBOARDING-V2-1-T1-AC10: The adopted web implementation preserves current-main package metadata including Node >=24 <25, uses repository primitives and Tailwind where appropriate, and splits the oversized onboarding route and workspace modules at real responsibility boundaries so route/page modules remain below 300 lines.

ONBOARDING-V2-1-T1-AC11: Focused browser, model, provider, lifecycle, OpenAPI, migration, and visual tests cover idempotency conflict, invalidation, service-Person ownership, harness values, secret modes, empty discovery, provider fallback, Teams setup-only behavior, DM/group rules, expiry/replay/mismatch, run and thread correlation, projection retry, migration journal integrity, immutable reference hash, and Console gating.

ONBOARDING-V2-1-T1-AC12: Lint, formatting, type checks, web and runtime builds, disposable-Postgres proof, deterministic Forge verification, one three-lens autoreview with motion review, and a rebuilt-runtime functional check of healthz, readyz, and ui/onboarding are recorded before the user-held PR handoff; live Slack tenant proof remains release-only.

non_blocking_findings.summary:
[P2] Document the 200 response returned by idempotent setup replay (apps/core/src/control/server/openapi-onboarding-routes.ts:47): Reviewer: chunk 2/3

The route documentation declares only a `201` success status for setup creation, while the reachable handler deliberately returns `200` when the idempotency key replays an existing setup.

Do not change the application-wide root scale for an onboarding-only layout (apps/web/src/styles.css:117): Reviewer: chunk 3/3

Changing `html` from 14px to 15px rescales every existing rem-based Tailwind font, spacing, and dimension across overview, preferences, and the rest of the console—not just the onboarding surface.
